subject.title: chore(scripts): remove resolved investigation tools and orphans

question: Should the Code Mode namespace registration API remain an owned runtime seam after its live investigation consumer is removed?
rationale: The failing branch proves that the deleted scripts were the only non-test consumer, but source ownership alone cannot determine whether those exports are intentionally retained for future plugin behavior or should be removed as stale internal API.

options.title: Remove the unowned namespace seam
options.body: Confirm it is not a supported plugin contract, then delete the registration exports and tests that exist only to preserve them.

options.title: Keep an owned Code Mode seam
options.body: Retain the API only with a current production owner or a narrowly justified supported test/runtime contract that dependency checks recognize.

options.title: Pause this cleanup slice
options.body: Land unrelated script removals later and leave the Code Mode repro/API decision to a focused owner-reviewed change.

recommendation.title: Remove the unowned namespace seam
recommendation.body: Confirm it is not a supported plugin contract, then delete the registration exports and tests that exist only to preserve them.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author surfaced the dependency-guard failure and the concrete Code Mode ownership alternatives.
